title: Discipline and Label: A WEIRD Genealogy and Social Theory of Data Annotation

bias_targets.methodology: Critical genealogy and theoretical synthesis drawing parallels between machine learning annotation pipelines and the WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) problem in experimental psychology, evaluating the mismatch of cultural contexts between data requesters and annotators.

Macro-level sociological analysis evaluating the global labor dynamics, structural inequalities, and power asymmetries between wealthy Global North technology companies and precarious data annotation platform workers in the Global South.

Micro-level theoretical analysis examining how an annotator's individual subjectivity, social positionality, and the constrained design of annotation tasks influence the automated social categorization of data.
